def get_divisors(n):
    if n == 0: return [] # special case handled in the loop
    divs = []
    for i in range(1, int(abs(n)**0.5) + 1):
        if n % i == 0:
            divs.append(i)
            divs.append(-i)
            divs.append(n // i)
            divs.append(-(n // i))
